source.title: NIST CSWP 29, The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
source.notes: Text copied verbatim from the PDF. Only the Categories and Subcategories used by the IR plan checklist are included. Subcategory numbering is intentionally not sequential in CSF 2.0: gaps are CSF 1.1 Subcategories that were relocated.

GV.PO.title: Policy
GV.PO.description: Organizational cybersecurity policy is established, communicated, and enforced

GV.RR.title: Roles, Responsibilities, and Authorities
GV.RR.description: Cybersecurity roles, responsibilities, and authorities to foster accountability, performance assessment, and continuous improvement are established and communicated

ID.IM.title: Improvement
ID.IM.description: Improvements to organizational cybersecurity risk management processes, procedures and activities are identified across all CSF Functions

DE.AE.title: Adverse Event Analysis
DE.AE.description: Anomalies, indicators of compromise, and other potentially adverse events are analyzed to characterize the events and detect cybersecurity incidents

RS.MA.title: Incident Management
RS.MA.description: Responses to detected cybersecurity incidents are managed

RS.AN.title: Incident Analysis
RS.AN.description: Investigations are conducted to ensure effective response and support forensics and recovery activities

RS.CO.title: Incident Response Reporting and Communication
RS.CO.description: Response activities are coordinated with internal and external stakeholders as required by laws, regulations, or policies

RS.MI.title: Incident Mitigation
RS.MI.description: Activities are performed to prevent expansion of an event and mitigate its effects

RC.RP.title: Incident Recovery Plan Execution
RC.RP.description: Restoration activities are performed to ensure operational availability of systems and services affected by cybersecurity incidents

RC.CO.title: Incident Recovery Communication
RC.CO.description: Restoration activities are coordinated with internal and external parties

subcategories.GV.PO-01: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is established based on organizational context, cybersecurity strategy, and priorities and is communicated and enforced
subcategories.GV.PO-02: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is reviewed, updated, communicated, and enforced to reflect changes in requirements, threats, technology, and organizational mission
subcategories.GV.RR-01: Organizational leadership is responsible and accountable for cybersecurity risk and fosters a culture that is risk-aware, ethical, and continually improving
subcategories.GV.RR-02: Roles, responsibilities, and authorities related to cybersecurity risk management are established, communicated, understood, and enforced
subcategories.GV.RR-03: Adequate resources are allocated commensurate with the cybersecurity risk strategy, roles, responsibilities, and policies
subcategories.GV.RR-04: Cybersecurity is included in human resources practices
subcategories.ID.IM-02: Improvements are identified from security tests and exercises, including those done in coordination with suppliers and relevant third parties
subcategories.ID.IM-03: Improvements are identified from execution of operational processes, procedures, and activities
subcategories.ID.IM-04: Incident response plans and other cybersecurity plans that affect operations are established, communicated, maintained, and improved
subcategories.PR.DS-11: Backups of data are created, protected, maintained, and tested
subcategories.PR.IR-03: Mechanisms are implemented to achieve resilience requirements in normal and adverse situations
subcategories.DE.AE-02: Potentially adverse events are analyzed to better understand associated activities
subcategories.DE.AE-03: Information is correlated from multiple sources
subcategories.DE.AE-04: The estimated impact and scope of adverse events are understood
subcategories.DE.AE-06: Information on adverse events is provided to authorized staff and tools
subcategories.DE.AE-07: Cyber threat intelligence and other contextual information are integrated into the analysis
subcategories.DE.AE-08: Incidents are declared when adverse events meet the defined incident criteria
subcategories.RS.MA-01: The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant third parties once an incident is declared
subcategories.RS.MA-02: Incident reports are triaged and validated
subcategories.RS.MA-04: Incidents are escalated or elevated as needed
subcategories.RS.MA-05: The criteria for initiating incident recovery are applied
subcategories.RS.AN-03: Analysis is performed to establish what has taken place during an incident and the root cause of the incident
subcategories.RS.AN-06: Actions performed during an investigation are recorded, and the records' integrity and provenance are preserved
subcategories.RS.AN-07: Incident data and metadata are collected, and their integrity and provenance are preserved
subcategories.RS.AN-08: An incident's magnitude is estimated and validated
subcategories.RS.CO-02: Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents
subcategories.RS.CO-03: Information is shared with designated internal and external stakeholders
subcategories.RC.RP-01: The recovery portion of the incident response plan is executed once initiated from the incident response process
subcategories.RC.RP-02: Recovery actions are selected, scoped, prioritized, and performed
subcategories.RC.RP-03: The integrity of backups and other restoration assets is verified before using them for restoration
subcategories.RC.RP-04: Critical mission functions and cybersecurity risk management are considered to establish post-incident operational norms
subcategories.RC.RP-05: The integrity of restored assets is verified, systems and services are restored, and normal operating status is confirmed
subcategories.RC.RP-06: The end of incident recovery is declared based on criteria, and incident-related documentation is completed
subcategories.RC.CO-03: Recovery activities and progress in restoring operational capabilities are communicated to designated internal and external stakeholders
subcategories.RC.CO-04: Public updates on incident recovery are shared using approved methods and messaging
